newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA TO KEEP MODERATELY TIGHT MONETARY POLICY.
newsitem.headline: CHINA TO KEEP MODERATELY TIGHT MONETARY POLICY.

text.p: China's central bank, the People's Bank of China, said on Thursday that it was committed to retaining an appropriately tight policy.
The central bank issued the comment in a statement on the performance of the financial sector so far this year.
"The financial sector remains committed in 1997 to pursuing the moderately tight monetary policy, safeguarding and mitigating financial risk," the bank said.
The policy was also aimed at supporting economic structural adjustment, it said, adding that this policy had contributed to the steady development of the financial industry.
China cut interest rates twice last year, easing a three-year-old credit squeeze but has since said repeatedly that it will retain an "appropriately tight" monetary policy.
